errorDescriptions.400: Invalid query (application/problem+json). strictQuery=true rejects unknown decoded names with fixed value-free guidance before D1/304; use supported names from this mounted OpenAPI operation, remove unknown keys, or set strictQuery=false. Send strictQuery once as exact true or false (default false); invalid/empty/repeated values fail before D1. The zod validator rejects empty, whitespace-only, repeated or over-100-Unicode-code-point `customerNumber`/`subCustomerNumber`, blank, repeated or over-100-Unicode-code-point `phone` (1..100 Unicode code points, never whitespace-only), `q` longer than 100 Unicode code points, repeated or overlength `comments` (send one comments fragment of at most 100 Unicode code points before trimming, or omit comments and retry; blank is omitted), an out-of-range `limit`/`offset`, an unknown `enabled` value, invalid/empty/repeated `hasAddresses` (send one hasAddresses=true, false or any, or omit the selector and retry), invalid/empty/repeated `addressRouteId` (send one canonical unpadded nonnegative ASCII safe integer, or omit it and retry), invalid/blank/overlength/repeated `addressFranchiseId` (send one nonblank opaque string of 1..100 Unicode code points, or omit it and retry), invalid/empty/repeated `addressEnabled` (send one addressEnabled=true, false or any, or omit the selector and retry), invalid/empty/repeated `hasPhone1`/`hasPhone2` (send one hasPhone1=true, false or any and one hasPhone2=true, false or any, or omit the selectors and retry), an unknown/empty/duplicate `fields` selector, invalid/repeated `order`, or an invalid `ids` primary-ID selector (empty, over-50, duplicate, repeated-key, or non-canonical member) before any D1 query runs. Supply each account-number key once with 1..100 Unicode code points including a non-whitespace character, or omit it, then retry. Send a single nonblank `phone` of 1..100 Unicode code points, or omit it. Send order=asc or order=desc exactly (case-sensitive), or omit it for asc. Invalid/repeated exactNext is rejected; send one exactNext=true or false, or omit it and retry. Errors name fields, never submitted values; see docs/PROBLEMS.md#bad-request.
Invalid customer id or fields selector (application/problem+json). An unknown/empty/duplicate `fields` name is rejected before any D1 query runs.

Invalid query (application/problem+json), rejected before any D1 query. streetAddress must be one nonblank stored street value of 1..200 Unicode code points; empty, whitespace-only, overlength and repeated values are invalid. URL-encode one nonblank stored street value or omit streetAddress and retry. strictQuery=true rejects unknown decoded names with fixed value-free guidance before D1/304; use supported names from this mounted OpenAPI operation, remove unknown keys, or set strictQuery=false. Send strictQuery once as exact true or false (default false); invalid/empty/repeated values fail before D1. Send `routeId` as one exact unpadded ASCII nonnegative safe integer, `franchiseId` as one nonblank opaque string of 1..100 Unicode code points, and `zip`, `city` and `state` each as one nonblank exact stored string of 1..100 Unicode code points; empty/whitespace-only, overlength and repeated scope keys are invalid. URL-encode one nonblank value for each named string field and retry without trimming significant whitespace. Repeated or overlength `driverNote` is invalid: send one driverNote of at most 100 Unicode code points before trimming, or omit it and retry; blank is omitted. Send `lastAuditDate` as one nonblank exact stored string of 1..100 Unicode code points; empty/whitespace-only, overlength and repeated keys are invalid. Send `hasLastAuditDate` once as exact true, false or any (default any); invalid/blank/repeated values fail before D1. Send `parentCustomerEnabled` once as exact true, false or any (default any); invalid/blank/repeated values fail before D1. The validator also rejects `q` longer than 100 Unicode code points, an out-of-range `limit`/`offset`, an unknown `enabled` or `extrasAllowed` value, an unknown `hasContainers` value, an unknown/empty/duplicate `fields` selector, invalid/repeated `order`, or an invalid `ids` primary-ID selector (empty, over-50, duplicate, repeated-key, or non-canonical member). Send order=asc or order=desc exactly (case-sensitive), or omit it for asc. Invalid/repeated exactNext is rejected; send one exactNext=true or false, or omit it and retry. Errors name fields, never submitted values. Correct the named field and retry. See docs/PROBLEMS.md#bad-request.
Invalid id or fields selector (application/problem+json). An unknown/empty/duplicate `fields` name is rejected before any D1 query runs.

Invalid query (application/problem+json). strictQuery=true rejects unknown decoded names with fixed value-free guidance before D1/304; use supported names from this mounted OpenAPI operation, remove unknown keys, or set strictQuery=false. Send strictQuery once as exact true or false (default false); invalid/empty/repeated values fail before D1. Send parentRouteId as one canonical unpadded ASCII decimal safe integer 0..9007199254740991; parentFranchiseId as one URL-encoded nonblank opaque string of 1..100 Unicode code points without trimming significant whitespace; parentEnabled as one exact true, false or any. Blank, invalid, overlength and repeated parent keys fail before D1, after authentication; correct the named format and retry, or omit only if no parent scope is intended. The zod validator rejects a non-canonical `containerTypeId` (anything but one unpadded ASCII nonnegative safe integer; `0` is literal stored zero), empty/whitespace-only/repeated `serialNumber`, `rfid`, `materialStream`, `color`, `serviceCodeType`, `serviceCodeInput`, `zip`, `locationAddress` or `state`, `locationAddress` longer than 200 Unicode code points, any other exact string selector or `q` longer than 100 Unicode code points, an out-of-range `limit`/`offset`, an unknown `enabled`/`onCall`/`gpsLocked` value, an invalid/blank/repeated `hasSerialNumber` or `hasRfid` (send one exact true, false or any for each, or omit it and retry), an unknown/empty/duplicate `fields` selector, invalid/repeated `order`, or an invalid `ids` primary-ID selector (empty, over-50, duplicate, repeated-key, or non-canonical member) before any D1 query runs. Send order=asc or order=desc exactly (case-sensitive), or omit it for asc. Invalid/repeated exactNext is rejected; send one exactNext=true or false, or omit it and retry. Errors name fields, never submitted values. For locationAddress or state, URL-encode one nonblank stored value within the named limit or omit the key, then retry. For materialStream/color, URL-encode one supported-length nonblank stored label or omit it and retry. For serviceCodeType/serviceCodeInput, URL-encode one supported-length nonblank stored entry or omit it and retry. Correct other named query keys and see docs/PROBLEMS.md#bad-request.
Invalid id or fields selector (application/problem+json). An unknown/empty/duplicate `fields` name is rejected before any D1 query runs.
